summary.name: FreeTube
summary.one_liner: FreeTube is an open source desktop YouTube client focused on watching YouTube privately, without account tracking or ads.
use_cases: Subscribe to channels without a Google account
Import YouTube subscriptions into a local feed
Keep YouTube history and playlists stored locally
summary.what_it_does: FreeTube is a YouTube client for Windows (10 and later), macOS (12 and later), and Linux. It lets users subscribe to channels without an account and stores subscriptions, playlists and history locally. It fetches data by scraping, either with local methods or optionally through the Invidious API. The interface is designed to look similar to YouTube, and it offers ad-free playback and importing subscriptions from YouTube. The project is free and open source under the AGPLv3 license.
notable: Stores all subscriptions, playlists and history locally, with no data sent to the internet
Optional Invidious API use for fetching data
Subscribe to channels without an account
caveats: Current download is a Beta release (0.25.3)
Data is fetched by scraping, which may be fragile if YouTube changes
